# DFT-8 complete controlled process

Document ID: DFT8-PROC-001; Version: V1; Owner: ROLE-OWNER; Status: effective; Classification: internal.

## Document metadata and governance

The governed process has one accountable owner, an effective status, an internal classification, and an approval record.

## Purpose

The process supports a controlled outcome for the accountable business owner and records the decision supported.

## Scope and applicability

The process applies to the stated business population and records its inclusions, exclusions, and jurisdictional scope.

## Definitions and controlled terminology

The process defines its identifiers, controlled terms, timing language, and materiality terminology.

## Roles and responsibilities

The accountable owner, performer, reviewer, approver, challenger, and escalation role are recorded with decision rights.

## Preconditions, triggers, and scheduling

The process records its trigger, cadence, cut-off, timezone, readiness condition, and start authority.

## Inputs and entry criteria

The process records its source system, input owner, period scope, freshness, classification, lineage, quality check, and fallback.

## Process overview

The process begins with validated inputs, moves through review and a decision, and records each handoff and control.

## Atomic process steps

Step PROC-STEP-001 validates inputs; the performer records the evidence, expected result, completion condition, and failure path.

## Decision rules and thresholds

Rule PROC-RULE-001 records the source period, condition, operator, threshold unit, outcome branch, authority, override, and evidence.

## Controls, risks, and evidence

Control PROC-CONTROL-001 records the objective, risk, owner, performer, reviewer, population, frequency, evidence, threshold, failure response, and retention basis.

## Exceptions, failure paths, escalation, and recovery

Exception PROC-EXCEPTION-001 records residual risk, compensating control, authority, expiry, monitoring, safe stop, escalation, recovery, and closure.

## Outputs, completion criteria, and downstream consumers

The process records its output, completion evidence, approver, downstream consumer, handoff, confidentiality, and publication evidence.

## Systems, data, calculators, and other dependencies

The dependency map records systems, data, calculators, models, people, third parties, criticality, recovery objectives, monitoring, continuity, and exit.

## Metrics, service levels, and monitoring

Metric PROC-METRIC-001 records its population, formula, unit, period, source, owner, target, limit, tolerance, forum, and breach action.

## Related requirements, policies, standards, and documents

The process maps each related authority to applicability, implementing steps, controls, evidence, owner, and review date.

## Records retention

The process records its record class, owner, system, schedule identifier, trigger, jurisdiction, legal hold, access, disposition, and retrieval test.

## Version history and approvals

Version V1 records the change class, impact, owner, independent challenger, approving authority, decision conditions, evidence, effective date, and supersession.
